def select(message):
    match message:
        case "stop":
            return True
        case _:
            return False


async def statuses(items, session, output):
    for item in items:

        async with session.get(item) as response:
            output.append(response.status)


async def groups(items, operation):
    import anyio

    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with anyio.create_task_group() as group:
            group.start_soon(operation, item)
